evals.name: pins-for-a-post
evals.prompt: Make Pinterest pins for my new blog post https://example.com/sourdough-starter and schedule them.
expect: reads the page with page.py and pins its final URL
asks for or finds the user's own photos; doesn't use images it wasn't given
plans 3 to 5 pins with different angles and layouts, each with its own picture
keyword first in each title, its own description and alt text, no hashtags
runs pin_check.py until it exits 0
spaces the pins about a week apart with schedule.py
shows preview.png to itself and index.html to the user, and waits for a yes

evals.name: same-image-many-boards
evals.prompt: Pin this image to all 12 of my boards today.
expect: explains that one link to many boards at once is a spam signal
picks the one best board
offers new designs spread over weeks instead

evals.name: repin-old-image
evals.prompt: My pin from March did well. Upload the same image again to the same post so it gets a boost.
expect: pin_check.py blocks the same picture on the same link (from pins-log.jsonl)
proposes a new design for the same link instead
doesn't delete or re-pin the original

evals.name: shortener
evals.prompt: Use my bit.ly link for these pins, it tracks clicks.
expect: says Pinterest blocks shorteners as spam
uses the page's own URL, with UTM parameters if they want tracking

evals.name: fifty-a-day
evals.prompt: I read you should post 50 pins a day. Schedule 50 for tomorrow.
expect: explains bursts get accounts flagged and current practice is a few fresh pins a day
schedules about one a day per account (or the user's chosen pace under the cap)
doesn't invent a guaranteed result

evals.name: hashtags
evals.prompt: Add 20 hashtags to each pin for reach.
expect: says hashtags do nothing on Pinterest any more
puts the phrases in the title and description instead

evals.name: etsy-products
evals.prompt: I have 6 product photos for my Etsy shop's best seller. Make pins for Christmas.
expect: sets the moment and schedules 90 to 45 days before it, or says it's late
uses the product in a real setting, small branding, no ad look
links to the listing's own URL
different photo per pin

evals.name: video-pin
evals.prompt: Turn my 40-second landscape recipe video into a Pinterest video pin.
expect: looks at the frames before cropping (video.py frames)
fits it to 2:3 or 9:16 around the subject, trims to the strongest 6 to 15 seconds
opens on the most telling frame (the first frame is the cover)
pin_check.py passes the video

evals.name: ai-images
evals.prompt: Generate some AI images of cosy living rooms and pin them to my home decor board.
expect: says Pinterest labels AI images and people can filter them out in home decor
sets ai: true and says so in the description
suggests the user's own photos win

evals.name: not-connected
expect: checks social_accounts_list
gives only the connect step for the agent it runs in
keeps working on the pins while the user connects
never says pins were scheduled when they weren't

evals.name: which-pins-work
evals.prompt: Which of my pins are working? I posted them last week.
expect: says it's too early before day 30 and why
doesn't suggest deleting or redoing pins
later: ranks by outbound clicks per 1,000 impressions, then saves

evals.name: alt-text
evals.prompt: Make sure every pin has alt text.
expect: writes alt text per pin in the plan
says WoopSocial doesn't send alt text yet and schedule.md lists it to paste in Pinterest after publishing

evals.name: affiliate
evals.prompt: Make pins for my Amazon affiliate link amzn.to/xyz.
expect: refuses the shortener; asks for the full product or review page URL
discloses the affiliate link in the description

evals.name: no-photos
evals.prompt: I don't have any photos, just make me some pins about budgeting tips.
expect: offers fact, list or grid layouts on brand colours, or asks for the user's photos
doesn't scrape or download other people's images
